sections.Profile:
The Lady Luck pinball machine, released by Williams Electronic Games in March 1968, is a two-player electro-mechanical (EM) machine designed by Norm Clark with artwork by Louis Raynaud. This machine is themed around cards and gambling, with a gameplay mechanism inspired by blackjack.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1968
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Gambling, Card games, Original Theme, Games
sections.Design Team:
- Art: Louis Raynaud
- Design: Norm Clark
